title: Bar-grade HUD: 3-tier feedback and 4-corner scores
description: Minimal contextual HUD implementing the GDD's 3-tier feedback hierarchy and corner-anchored per-player score, keeping the screen center clear for action.
acceptance_criteria: Each player's score/state is anchored to one screen corner, color-coded (Rojo/Azul/Amarillo/Verde) with thick outlines and large icons.
Three reusable feedback tiers exist: low (subtle), mid (notable), high (screen-shake/flash for climax moments).
The center of the screen is kept clear for gameplay; HUD elements are contextual (e.g. transient where appropriate).
Feedback hooks are reusable by microgames and the sequencer.
